You may use the following helper functions:

chain_start(chain)
chain_end(chain)
chain_length(chain)

chain_start(chain) returns the first item of the chain.

chain_end(chain) returns the last item of the chain.

chain_length(chain) returns the number of items in the chain.

chain_pairs(chain) returns a list of all the pairs in the chain.
